posts.title: Autofilling in the Blanks
posts.description: If you have forms in your app that collect user information, autofill is one of the easiest accessibility wins you can add. Autofill is both an accessibility and a usability feature. And you can support it with just a few lines of code. What is Autofill? So, what is autofill, anyway?
